title: Hiro hình thái 2 · bị đánh
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body, weapon and shield always inside the frame with a margin, the face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth, cape and loose pieces always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

edits.recoil: Change only his pose and expression: he is struck hard from the right side, his eyes squeezed shut in pain, head and shoulders thrown back toward the left, knees bent absorbing the blow, still holding his sword. No motion lines, sweat drops, shadow or effects. Keep exactly the same character, costume, colours and sword design, the same size and position in the picture, flat magenta background.

segments.name: K2
segments.prompt: A chibi young boy swordsman with messy light-brown hair with an ahoge, brown eyes, a long tattered olive-green scarf and cape, a steel shoulder guard, a quilted brown leather jerkin, leather bracers, brown trousers and boots, holding a plain steel sword in his right hand, already recoiling from a hard hit at the first frame, dazed with eyes shut, immediately begins recovering: no second jolt. He opens his eyes, steadies himself with a slight knee flex and returns smoothly to his guard stance of the last frame; hair and cape swing with one diminishing overshoot. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding or hopping; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve his identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid sword, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.
